Title: Initiation
Key Concepts: Parts of guitar; tuning; pick vs fingers; posture; fretting clean notes; pulse
Practice Tasks: Tune guitar; fret single notes; clap quarter notes
Pass Condition: Can tune; can play single notes cleanly; can clap steady quarter notes

Title: First Chords
Key Concepts: Em G C D Am E A; chord changes; simple strumming; song sections
Pass Condition: Can change 4-6 chords without stopping; can play 3 simple songs

Title: Rhythm Foundation
Key Concepts: Down/up strumming; eighth notes; muted strums; accents; metronome
Pass Condition: Can keep time through a full song

Title: Fretboard Orientation
Key Concepts: String names; natural notes; octave shapes; sharps/flats; 12-fret repeat
Practice Tasks: Find notes on E and A strings
Pass Condition: Can find natural notes on low E and A; can identify roots

Title: Technique Core
Key Concepts: Alternate picking; hammer-ons; pull-offs; slides; bends; vibrato; palm muting; fingerpicking
Pass Condition: Can play simple riffs cleanly; can control muting and note length

Title: Barre Chords & Movable Shapes
Key Concepts: F chord; E-shape barre; A-shape barre; power chords; sus/add9/7ths
Pass Condition: Can play basic barre chords and transpose shapes

Title: Scales & Lead Guitar
Learning Objective: Start improvising and writing melodic lines
Key Concepts: Minor pentatonic; major pentatonic; blues scale; major scale; phrasing
Pass Condition: Can improvise a simple intentional solo

Title: Useful Theory
Key Concepts: Intervals; major scale formula; triads; diatonic chords; roman numerals; progressions
Pass Condition: Can explain common progressions and build triads

Title: Ear Training
Key Concepts: Match pitch; major/minor; intervals; chord movement; singing; transcription
Practice Tasks: Sing melodies; work out riffs by ear
Pass Condition: Can work out simple melodies and identify chord qualities

Title: Repertoire & Song Learning
Key Concepts: Easy songs; intermediate songs; songs by ear; full arrangements; memory
Pass Condition: Can play 20 songs; perform 3 without stopping

Title: Style Paths
Key Concepts: Acoustic; rock; blues; jazz; metal; worship/ambient
Practice Tasks: Choose a style path and collect songs/resources
Pass Condition: Can play core rhythm/lead ideas in chosen style

Title: Improvisation
Key Concepts: Chord tones; motifs; space; dynamics; question/answer phrasing
Practice Tasks: Improvise over one chord and chord changes
Pass Condition: Can improvise over 12-bar blues with structure

Title: Composition & Arrangement
Key Concepts: Progressions; riffs; intros/outros; solo arrangement; recording demos
Practice Tasks: Write and record an original piece
Pass Condition: Can write a complete original or arrangement

Title: Performance
Key Concepts: Practice sets; mistake recovery; tone setup; playing with others; recording
Pass Condition: Can perform 3 songs and recover from mistakes
